text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Shuka Sho. Back in Kyoto, 
just like her debut race, Vivlos was 
welcomed by a massive crowd of fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Around her debut, nearly all her fans had 
been fans of her mother or sister, but now 
she was surrounded by cheers meant 
entirely for herself. Vivlos's family had 
also rushed over to support her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've done everything I possibly can— 
Spurred on by her Trainer's encouragement, 
Vivlos resolutely headed off to the race.
